in_sanskrit.name: Sharishtha
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root 'shri' meaning 'excellence, prosperity,' and the suffix '-ishtha' meaning 'excellent, perfect, pure.' This name conveys the idea of being of the highest quality and standard.

in_hindi.name: Sharish
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler, King, Lord
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sharish एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name of God, representing the ruler of all beings, the lord of the universe, the king of gods. This name is associated with power, knowledge, and loyalty.
